findings.title: Attention Factors for Statistical Arbitrage
findings.summary: Conditional latent factors via attention over 39 firm characteristics. OOS Sharpe 2.3 net (5bp) on US 500-stock 1998-2021. Joint one-step optimization of factor structure + trading. GPU-intensive but no recurring API cost. H347 design.

findings.title: QuantaAlpha: Evolutionary Framework for LLM-Driven Alpha Mining
findings.summary: Trajectory-level LLM evolution for alpha factor discovery. CSI300 IC=0.1501. S&P500 transfer: 19.1% cumulative excess (4yr). pip install quantalpha. $5-20/run. H349 design.

findings.title: From Hypotheses to Factors: Constrained LLM Agents in Cryptocurrency Markets
findings.summary: Reproducible LLM factor discovery via restricted DSL (no lookahead). Crypto OOS Sharpe 1.55, 44.55% annualized. Needs equity DSL redesign for US large-cap. H288 design.
findings.action: H288 — redesign DSL grammar for equity; test IS 2020-2022, OOS 2023+

findings.title: TreEvo: Tree-Structured Thought Evolution for Alpha Mining
findings.summary: Hierarchical tree-structured LLM evolution. SPX IC=0.0317, +10% over EoH. 200 evaluations in 20 min, $3-10 API cost. Eliminates positional bias in flat-prompt factor evolution. Key ablation: tree-structure = +23.98% IC gain, operators = +10.19% additional. Compatible with DeepSeek V3, Qwen3, GPT-5.1.
findings.action: H352 NEW — implement TreEvo loop; IS 2016-2022, OOS 2023-2026; gate: IC >= 0.025 OOS

findings.title: Hubble: LLM-Driven Agentic Framework for Alpha Discovery
findings.summary: AST sandbox + dual-channel RAG (success + failure) + family-aware factor selection. Tested US 500-stock Jun 2025-Mar 2026. 0% crashes. Range/volatility factors positive OOS; trend factors decay. $25-50/run.
findings.action: wiki reference only — included in auto-alpha-discovery.md
findings.notes: Covered in wiki page. Too expensive for regular nightly runs.

findings.title: Cross-Market Alpha: Testing Short-Term Trading Factors in the U.S. Market via Double-Selection LASSO
findings.summary: 17 price-volume/microstructural signals from Chinese A-share markets identified via double-selection LASSO as significant on US S&P 500 (2002-2022) after controlling for 151 established factors. Signals include: rank of delayed price-gap correlation, overnight gap return, volume-intraday correlation, and 14 others. Direct extension candidate for H198 signal set.
findings.action: H353 NEW — test transfer signals as H198 composite extension; IS 2013-2020, OOS 2021-2026

findings.title: The Bounce Has No Direction: Sign, Magnitude, and Microstructure of Equity Return Predictability
findings.summary: FRI decomposition shows SPY lag-1 autocorrelation driven by magnitude (bid-ask bounce) not direction. Lag-3 directional reversal signal hidden from standard tests. Operates at intraday/daily frequency — not actionable at monthly rebalance.
findings.action: none — microstructure only, not applicable to monthly strategies

findings.title: Cross-Stock Predictability via LLM-Augmented Semantic Networks
findings.summary: 10-K embeddings → sparse candidate graph → LLM filters edges by economic relations → mean-reversion signals. L-S Sharpe 0.742→0.820, MaxDD -10.47%→-7.85%. S&P 500 2011-2019. H319 design already in queue.
findings.action: H319 — already queued; this paper confirms specific Sharpe improvement from LLM edge filtering
findings.notes: Already in H319 queue. Sharpe 0.742→0.820 is modest but consistent with LLM filtering providing signal quality improvement.

findings.title: LLM as a Risk Manager: LLM Semantic Filtering for Lead-Lag Trading in Prediction Markets
findings.summary: LLM suppresses statistically fragile lead-lag relationships in Kalshi prediction markets. ADF + Granger causality with LLM semantic filter. Kalshi data Oct 2021-Nov 2025. Relevant for H319 concept but prediction markets not equities.
findings.action: none — prediction markets context; concept transferred to H319

findings.title: Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large Language Models
findings.summary: FinBERT + LLM ensemble achieves 57.6-58.3% directional accuracy on earnings-day PEAD. H348 design already in queue.

findings.title: LiveTradeBench: Seeking Real-World Alpha with Large Language Models
findings.summary: Benchmark of 21 LLMs on live daily trading (US stocks + Polymarket). High LMArena score ≠ superior trading. Models show distinct portfolio styles. Daily rebalancing — not applicable to monthly strategies.
